Like VS Code Remote-SSH, without leaving the conversation."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## ✨ Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **Multi-server connection management** (Settings → Remote Workspace): SSH alias (`~/.ssh/config` H"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ost) or host/port/user modes; switch connections anytime; config persists in browser localStorage

- "},{"id":"p6s9","text":"**Conversation-direct**: ask the agent in chat to operate on server files directly"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## 🥇 Why this plugin?"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Compared with other DSH SSH / remote-file-browser plugins:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **Multi-server, not single-server** — add and switch any number of SSH connections (alias or host/"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"port/user); most similar plugins hard-code one server

-"},{"id":"p9s4","text":" **Dock / Float dual modes** — dock beside the conversation (auto-reflow + draggable divider) or one"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"-click widen to a 1400px floating panel; other panels usually just overlay the page
- **Syntax highl"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"ighting + line numbers** — IDE-like code reading (keywords / strings / comments / numbers / decorato"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"rs), not a plain textarea
